description: Compare effective first-order and dose-modulated assay responses after a short disclosed fluorescence calibration. Signal amplitudes remain instrument units, not inferred molecular concentrations.
independent_unit: Whole dose curves; original confirmation and compact-v2 development assignments retained
limitations: Effective saturation kinetics, not identified catalytic reaction steps
Initial signal and slope use only 3, 4.5 and 6 minute observations
Whole biosensor-dose curves held out, with no biological replicate identities
Fluorescence is uncalibrated instrument response and cannot be interpreted as molar product
title: Saturation dynamics of a kinase biosensor
